text: Hi. Uh, are you Sarah?
No, I’m not. I’m her older sister.
Well, I’m here to talk to her . . .
I know why you’re here.
Good. Uh, Is Sarah here?
Um, I first have a couple of questions, and you [had] better answer them.
First of all, what is your name?
Uh, my name? I’m Nick . . .
I thought so. Where are you from?
Um. I’m from Brownsville. Why are you asking me . . .
Okay. How old are you?
What!?
How old are you?
Does that matter?
Of course, it matters. I wouldn’t be asking otherwise.
Really?
Really. Yeah. Sarah’s only 19.
Okay, I’m 22. Now, is Sarah here?
Where did you first meet Sarah and why do you like her so much?
Like her? What do you mean? I’ve only met her once in . . .
Don’t lie to me, Nick.
Are you sure you have the right guy?
Listen. Are you sure? [I’m sure, I’m sure.] Listen.
I’m leaving. I don’t need the money THAT much.
Money? Wait! What do you mean?
Listen. I’m a teaching assistant at the university, and I met Sarah in the Spanish class last week.
She asked me if I could teach her, you know, help her with her class.
So, you’re not Nick Roberts, that guy that drives that crazy motorcycle?
[No!] The one with the large tattoo of a large snake across his back?
No! What? You’ve got the wrong guy.
I’m leaving. This whole thing is crazy.
